content.comment_body: Hello, has anyone tried performing more complex mathematical tasks in [product_name] Soft Comfort? I need to process some data sent via modbus protocol. The standard math instruction block only allows basic operations ('+', '-', '*', '/'), but I need to calculate x = √(a² + b²) and can't find any way to do a square root calculation. Any advice would be appreciated.
What is the sum of (a² + b²)? If it exceeds 32,767, I don't think it's possible.
It will definitely be higher. Thanks for the clarification.
Hello, has anyone managed to calculate a square root in [product_name]? For example, using the Newton method?
[product_name] only supports integer values, not floating point numbers.

On the German section of this forum, I found a topic about complex calculations. Check page 2 for the post by [user_name] dated 14.08.2013. I tested the UDF 'Wurzel_opt_32767.lma'. See the attached file for reference.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face major limitations when trying to perform advanced math operations, such as calculating a square root, in [product_name] Soft Comfort. The application only supports basic arithmetic and integer values, making it difficult to work with Modbus data or perform more complex calculations. Some users express frustration about the lack of functionality for mathematical tasks beyond simple integer arithmetic.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Soft Comfort to offer native support for advanced math functions, like square root, and to work with values larger than typical integer limits.
